description: This file defines classes related to exception handling and trapping for the SimpleTest PHP testing framework, including exception expectation, trapping, and invocation decorators.

classes.name: SimpleExceptionTrappingInvoker
classes.description: Decorator class that wraps a test invoker to trap exceptions and report unhandled ones.

classes.name: ExceptionExpectation
classes.description: Defines expectations for exceptions, matching by type or message.

classes.name: SimpleExceptionTrap
classes.description: Stores expected exceptions, intercepts thrown exceptions, and reports untrapped exceptions.

methods.name: SimpleExceptionTrappingInvoker::__construct
methods.description: Constructor that stores the invoker to be wrapped.

methods.name: SimpleExceptionTrappingInvoker::invoke
methods.description: Invokes a test method while trapping exceptions and reporting unhandled ones.

methods.name: ExceptionExpectation::__construct
methods.description: Initializes the expectation with a class name or exception object.

methods.name: ExceptionExpectation::test
methods.description: Tests if a given exception matches the expectation.

methods.name: ExceptionExpectation::testMessage
methods.description: Creates a message describing the exception test.

methods.name: ExceptionExpectation::describeException
methods.description: Returns a string description of an exception.

methods.name: SimpleExceptionTrap::__construct
methods.description: Initializes the trap and clears previous expectations.

methods.name: SimpleExceptionTrap::expectException
methods.description: Sets up an expected exception to trap.

methods.name: SimpleExceptionTrap::isExpected
methods.description: Checks if an exception matches the expected exception.

methods.name: SimpleExceptionTrap::getOutstanding
methods.description: Returns a message if an exception was expected but not trapped.

methods.name: SimpleExceptionTrap::clear
methods.description: Resets the trap's expected exception and message.
